title: Taj Exotica Resort
description: A 5-star beachfront resort set across 56 acres of manicured Mediterranean-inspired tropical gardens with direct access to Benaulim Beach.

title: Kumarakom Lake Resort
description: Designed around traditional Kerala architecture and restored heritage homesteads along a winding pool and man-made lagoon overlooking Vembanad Lake. Offers luxury pavilion rooms, meandering pool villas, heritage villas (including private pool and lake-view options), houseboats, and presidential suites.

title: The Leela Palace
description: Set on 4.8 acres along Adyar Sea Face in MRC Nagar, Chennai, this palatial property blends classical Tamil heritage with modern luxury, offering butler service, a twilight theepantham ritual, a wellness spa, and dining spots including Spectra, Jamavar, and China XO.

title: ITC Grand Chola
description: Inspired by Imperial Chola architecture, featuring hand-carved pillars, Italian marble, 522 rooms and 78 serviced apartments (or up to 600 keys depending on configuration), and large banquet/convention facilities.

title: The oberoi
description: Extremely spacious, with wall to wall windows that capture magnificent ocean and cityscape views. Our accommodation has been designed for business and leisure travellers to Mumbai. With comfortable furnishings, large writing desks, complimentary high-speed Internet for up to four devices and 24-hour butler service. Plus, female butlers for our lady guests.

title: Bangi Resort
description: A picturesque 5-star conference resort hotel, conveniently located midway between Kuala Lumpur International Airport and Kuala Lumpur city centre. Built atop Bandar Baru Bangi’s highest peak, it is surrounded by a 27-hole championship golf course, lush tropical greens and offers a wonderful vista and serene environment.

title: City Center Executive Suites
description: Modern business hotel located in the heart of the city with high-speed WiFi and conference halls.
